info.title: dydo
info.description: An AI orchestration and context-management framework for Claude Code.

commands.name: notion
commands.description: Sync dydo docs with a Notion workspace

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Store a Notion integration token (read from stdin, never echoed)

options.name: --parent-page
options.description: Notion page id the spine databases are provisioned under; written to dydo.json.

options.name: --vault
options.description: Seal the token into a committed, passphrase-encrypted vault instead of the local-only store. [default: False]

commands.name: reveal-token
commands.description: Print the stored Notion token (guarded — exposes a secret)

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the interactive confirmation. [default: False]

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Reconcile dydo docs against the configured Notion workspace

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Compute and print the reconcile plan without applying any change. [default: False]

options.name: --prune
options.description: Delete schema drift: properties or select options present in Notion but absent from the project's sync model. Without it, drift is warned about and left untouched. [default: False]

options.name: --parent-page
options.description: Notion page id to mirror under, overriding notion.parentPageId / DYDO_NOTION_PARENT_PAGE. Point it at a scratch page to smoke-test without touching the configured workspace.

options.name: --docs
options.description: Also run the docs nested-page mirror alongside the PM spine. Off by default — the plain sync runs the spine only. [default: False]

options.name: --docs-only
options.description: Run only the docs nested-page mirror, skipping the PM spine. Mutually exclusive with --spine-only. [default: False]

options.name: --spine-only
options.description: Run only the PM spine, skipping the docs mirror (the default scope). Mutually exclusive with --docs-only. [default: False]

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Wipe the tracked Notion databases and recreate them fresh from the sync model

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the archive + recreate plan without touching Notion. [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the destructive-action confirmation prompt. [default: False]

options.name: --parent-page
options.description: Notion page id to recreate the spine under, overriding notion.parentPageId / DYDO_NOTION_PARENT_PAGE. Point it at a scratch page to reset a throwaway workspace.

commands.name: model
commands.description: Temporarily cap an unavailable model to a fallback tier

commands.name: cap
commands.description: Rebind every tier on MODEL to a fallback until a reset time, then re-sync

options.name: --until
options.description: When the cap lifts, as stated in the limit error: [yyyy-]mm-dd hh:mm (local time).

options.name: --fallback
options.description: Model to rebind the capped tiers to. Defaults to models.fallback in dydo.json.

arguments.name: MODEL
arguments.description: The unavailable model id to cap (e.g. claude-fable-5).

commands.name: uncap
commands.description: Restore MODEL's tier bindings, clear the cap, and re-sync

arguments.name: MODEL
arguments.description: The capped model id to restore (e.g. claude-fable-5).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show active model caps and their reset times
